_doc: UNATTENDED-365 (Rowan, 2026-11-20): "The Ultrastable system shall be able to run entirely unattended for 1 year with zero external input and continue to deploy new releases regularly completely on its own code loops." This is the register of every external input the system still has: credentials, renewals, quotas, hosted models, dependencies, outside sessions and the acts only a person's identity can do. status closed = renews or repairs itself, with the probe that proves it; gate = identity-bound (money, sign-in, legal), with the default in effect and one link; open = closable in code, with a queue item. horizon_days is the days until the first non-renewing input lapses. Consumers: foundation/unattended.py (--check inside `openloops --check`; --horizon), foundation/needsyou.py (a closed dependency removes its act from NEEDS-YOU.md), doctrine/rules.json rule no-open-items, tests/foundation/test_unattended.py.

target.statement: Designed to run unattended for a minimum of one year, completely on its own: it keeps its cost down, finds what fails and fixes it, and keeps getting better (Rowan, 2026-11-20).

pillars.statement: It spends nothing a person has to pay for
It finds what fails and fixes it: no clock stays stopped
It gets better by itself: it originates and ships its own deploys

target.principle: A code agent session, scheduled or hand-started, is an outside input and never counts. Only deploys the system originated and executed itself count (self_deploys).
